verdict.rationale: Mistral documents audio input through Voxtral, with several file-passing methods (mistral-docs-31). Mistral Large 3's model card calls it a 'flagship multimodal' model, and document upload is supported via the Document Library RAG tool. Community hands-on reports confirm the OCR endpoint accepts PDFs and PNGs; their accuracy complaints concern quality, not whether input is accepted. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on image/vision input format, documented OCR/document endpoint details (a community user reports these are missing), and per-model modality scoping.
